description.html: This glass terrarium (60x30x25 cm, 45 L) comes with exterior decorative film in a pattern of your choice. The glass gives a clear view of the inside, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security.

A length of 60 cm and a width of 30 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The floor dimensions allow a basking spot at one end and a cooler hide at the other. Mesh covers on the ventilation openings let air through but not food or the small inhabitants of the terrarium.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
